rights_basis: This focused transcription reproduces a few sentences of the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers English translation, which is in the United States public domain by date of publication. It is derived from page images rendered from the hashed Internet Archive facsimile of that printing and contains no Internet Archive markup.
text: I say this, lest thou shouldest wonder how it could be that Mary wept bitterly at the tomb, while Peter was in no way so affected. Because hers was a feeble nature, and she as yet knew not accurately the account of the Resurrection; whereas they having seen the linen clothes and believed, departed to their own homes in astonishment.
